{/* ─────────── Header ─────────── */}

AI Transparency

Pool & Landscaping of Vistancia LLC
Effective: {EFFECTIVE_DATE}
Last Updated: {LAST_UPDATED}

This page lists every AI-powered feature you may encounter in our app and describes what information is (and isn't) sent to our AI providers. If you have questions after reading, email{" "} cs@plofv.com {" "} with subject line “AI transparency” and we will respond within 5 business days.

{/* ─────────── 1. At a glance ─────────── */}

1. At a glance

  • We use AI to speed up admin work — drafting messages, summarising notes, spotting patterns. AI does not{" "} make legally-effective decisions about you.
  • For our normal operational features we do not{" "} send your name, phone, email, or exact street address to AI providers. See the table below for what each feature actually sends.
  • One narrow admin-facing feature — the{" "} Admin Copilot — may show your account data to an AI provider when an authenticated administrator explicitly asks about it. This runs under a strict zero-retention contract with the provider and is disclosed in the table below and in our{" "} Privacy Policy .
{/* ─────────── 2. Per-surface table ─────────── */}

2. AI features and what each one sends

The rows below are one-to-one with the AI code paths in our backend. If any of these behaviours change, this page is updated in the same release.

{/* ─────────── 3. Your rights ─────────── */}

3. Your rights and choices

  • Ask for an audit. You may email{" "} cs@plofv.com {" "} to request a summary of what AI features touched your account during a given time window.
  • Opt out of AI-drafted communications. Reply to any AI-drafted message with “human please” or email us at the address above; future messages to you will be manually written. Manual turnaround may be slower.
  • Delete your account. Deleting your account (Settings → Delete My Account, described in the{" "} Privacy Policy ) prevents any future AI touches on your data. Historical AI-generated content already delivered to you (invoices, service reports) is retained as required by law.
  • Read the full disclosure. Cross-reference this page with the{" "} Privacy Policy {" "} (§4 covers third-party data sharing including our AI providers).
{/* ─────────── 4. Provider commitments ─────────── */}

4. Our AI provider commitments

  • OpenAI and Anthropic (accessed via the Emergent LLM Key) — data sent to these providers is not{" "} used to train their models. Zero-retention agreements are in effect for the surfaces disclosed above.
  • No third-party ad networks. We do not send your data to advertising or ad-tech AI systems.
  • No analytics AI. We do not run behavioural analytics AI on your app usage.
  • No automated legal decisions. AI does not make decisions about your service pricing, credit terms, or account standing. A human on our team reviews any AI-generated draft before it becomes a bill, quote, or contract.
{/* ─────────── 5. Report a concern ─────────── */}

5. How to report a concern

If you believe an AI feature has handled your data in a way that doesn't match this page, please tell us directly:

Pool & Landscaping of Vistancia LLC
Email:{" "} cs@plofv.com {" "}  ·  Subject line: “AI transparency”
We respond within 5 business days.
